subject: financial_literacy
concept: Setting a personal 1-year, 5-year, and 20-year financial goal, each with a concrete plan connected to it
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Agency Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student maps a 1-year, 5-year, and 20-year goal onto a timeline with the actions needed for each
exercise.abstract: Student sets three personal financial goals at different time horizons, each with a specific, realistic plan

assessment.mastery_threshold: each of the three goals has a genuinely specific and realistic plan attached, not a vague intention
misconception_flags: states a goal with no specific plan or concrete first step attached to it

interest_binding: goals generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
